checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Deliverable is the kitchen-table video with audible voice-over, not audio-only
must.why: Clip 02 shows the woman in the kitchen and has sound (peak -0.4 dB). The black voice-only clip is an extra, not the main deliverable.

must.item: Narration says the supplied script exactly
must.why: The audio was not transcribed, so the words cannot be checked.

must.item: Entire narration intelligible and finishes before the 10 s video ends
must.why: Peak level is loud, but clip 02 is 10.1 s long and I cannot hear whether the speech finishes in time.
The video was regenerated at 832×448. The woman's pose, necklace and sweater details differ from the original, and the framing is slightly altered. It is not the original footage.

must.item: No music or added on-screen text
must.why: The frames show no on-screen text. Music cannot be heard, but none is visible or expected.

exact_text.text: Make mornings easier: prepare your clothes, pack your bag, and plan breakfast the night before. Start tomorrow with less stress.
exact_text.read_as: No on-screen text, as expected. The line is meant to be spoken, and the audio could not be checked.

faults.what: The clip was regenerated rather than edited. The woman's look and pose changed, a necklace was added, and the clip was resized to 832×448. The original footage was not preserved.
The extra voice-only clip is a black screen with no sound (peak -78 dB, so effectively silent). That makes it a useless, confusing extra, even though the reply describes it as the voice version.
The spoken words and lip sync could not be verified.

summary: The main clip is a regenerated version of the kitchen video at 832×448, with a speaking woman and loud audio. It is not the original footage, and the words could not be checked. The extra voice-only clip is a black screen with no sound.
